name: io.github.bountyoperator/bounty-operator
title: Bounty Operator
description: Argues against a security finding or a draft bug bounty report before you submit it.

environmentVariables.name: BOUNTY_OPERATOR_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Connection token (bok_...) from the account panel at bountyoperator.com. The account and run_review tools use it; every other tool works with none.

environmentVariables.name: BOUNTY_OPERATOR_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model id run_review uses when a call names none.

environmentVariables.name: BOUNTY_OPERATOR_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the project folder that file paths resolve under. Defaults to the directory the server starts in.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter API key, for run_review with provider openrouter.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key, for run_review with provider anthropic.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key, for run_review with provider openai.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gemini API key, for run_review with provider gemini.

environmentVariables.name: XAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: xAI API key, for run_review with provider xai.

environmentVariables.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: DeepSeek API key, for run_review with provider deepseek.

environmentVariables.name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Mistral API key, for run_review with provider mistral.

environmentVariables.name: GROQ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Groq API key, for run_review with provider groq.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Connection token from the account panel at bountyoperator.com. The account and run_review tools use it; every other tool works with none.

headers.name: X-Provider-Key
headers.description: API key of the model provider that run_review calls.
